ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light-grey) to 40% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe features dense, fine-grained black stippling/mottling across a white field. Right lobe contains a larger contiguous high-intensity white area with a central low-intensity circular spot (approx. coordinate mid-right) and localized black mottling near the trailing edge. Central fluke region is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute internal angle; depth is roughly 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; numerous small peaks and valleys are visible along the entire length of both lobes, particularly pronounced on the left lobe's outer half.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct concave curve from the median notch to the lateral tips; leading edge (where visible) appears convex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, circular white/brown barnacle attachments are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel high-intensity white linear streaks oriented nearly vertically on the right lobe, intersecting the darker stippled region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent white linear rake-style marks on the right lobe; small dark circular lesions or pockmarks visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular spot located in the center-right of the right lobe, surrounded by a high-intensity white field.
